tools.name: get_page_context
tools.description: Read the current SearchSpot page: path, title, and which travel tools apply here.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Open a SearchSpot page. Use page for a named surface, or path for a known in-app URL such as /places/tokyo or /trip/abc.

path.description: Root-relative SearchSpot path, for example /places/tokyo or /chat?q=Lisbon.

tools.name: plan_around_place
tools.description: Start a trip that includes a place. On a public place page, placeName defaults to that place. Same action as the Plan trip button.

placeName.description: Place to include. Optional when the current page is already a place guide.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search flights. Accepts origin, destination, and dates in the traveler's words or as YYYY-MM-DD. Opens the same planning chat the Flights page uses.

origin.description: Departure city or airport, such as "London" or "LHR".

destination.description: Arrival city or airport, such as "New York" or "JFK".

departureDate.description: Outbound date, such as 2026-09-04 or next Thursday.

cabinClass.description: Cabin preference such as Economy, Premium Economy, Business, or First.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search hotels or a specific stay. Accepts destination and stay dates in the traveler's words or as YYYY-MM-DD. Set destinationType to property when the traveler named a hotel; leave it as area for a city or neighborhood. Opens the same planning chat the Hotels page uses.

destination.description: City, area, or hotel name, such as "Lisbon" or "Sea Hills Hotels".

destinationType.description: Use property for a specific hotel or lodging name; use area for a city, neighborhood, or destination. Defaults to area.

checkIn.description: Check-in date, such as 2026-09-04 or 4 September 2026.

checkOut.description: Check-out date, such as 2026-09-08 or 8 September 2026.

starRating.description: Preferred star rating. Defaults to Any.

tools.name: start_planning
tools.description: Start a SearchSpot trip-planning chat with the traveler request in their own words. Use this for destinations, dates, budget, vibe, or open-ended travel questions.

prompt.description: The traveler request, such as "Plan a long weekend in Kyoto in October for two".
